title: Anthropic expands science credits through research institutions
dek: Anthropic’s science-program expansion distributes Claude credits through institutions and funders, adding an access route for research teams.

sources.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions, October 28, 2026
Previewing the Model Hardware Standard, August 27, 2026

lede: Anthropic announced an AI for Science expansion on October 28, naming 20 foundations, institutions and research groups receiving support. The change gives researchers an institutional route to Claude credits alongside a program that began with individual scientists.

facts.label: Support
facts.value: Free Claude credits for scientific projects

facts.label: Related hardware work
facts.value: Model Hardware Standard; research preview since 27 Aug 2026

body.heading: Institutions distribute the credits
body.text: Anthropic names organizations including the Simons Foundation, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Space Telescope Science Institute and EMBL. Funders will distribute credits to researchers, while institutional partners will use credits within their organizations. The company expects some supported projects to produce shared datasets, software and standards. For a research software team, the immediate decision is which access route fits its institution and project. A credit award should be planned alongside the staff time needed to review outputs and maintain any resulting tools.

body.heading: Hardware access is a separate project
body.text: The announcement also references the Model Hardware Standard developed with HHMI Janelia. That effort entered research preview on August 27 and addresses connections between agents and programmable equipment. It is separate from distributing model credits. Teams considering both should keep the access budget and the equipment-integration review separate.

buildersNote: Ask the participating institution for allocation size, expiry and renewal terms before committing a project budget. For hardware work, separately confirm programmable interfaces and assign an expert to review the proposed operating procedure.

claims.text: Anthropic names 20 organizations in its October 28 program expansion
The Model Hardware Standard entered research preview on August 27
